label: Blind sample 002: Hansen forest loss 2019, tile 60N_100E

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.25 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2019 (90% interval −0.27 to −0.07). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 1 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.03). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02). No fake-date test was possible here (too few observation periods before the event), so a decline that began before the date given cannot be ruled out.

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.25); radar is inconclusive (radar backscatter (VH) −1.0 dB, interval −1.4 to −0.7).
